notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: I read the complete held EO 12604 (52 FR 29495, signed August 5, 1987, Presidential Board of Advisors on Private Sector Initiatives): it amends EO 12528 to raise the Board's maximum membership from 30 to 35 (sec. 1(a)) and to rewrite sec. 4(a) as 'The Board shall terminate on July 1, 1989, unless sooner extended.' It is purely an amending order with no independent command; its text lives inside EO 12528. I read the held full text of EO 12692 (54 FR 40627, signed September 29, 1989, Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees): sec. 3 provides 'The following Executive orders, which established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed, are revoked:', item (f) 'Executive Order No. 12528, as amended by Executive Order No. 12604, establishing the Presidential Board of Advisors on Private Sector Initiatives'; sec. 5 makes the order effective September 30, 1989. That revokes the parent with EO 12604's amendments and names EO 12604 expressly. D6 self-check: the amended EO 12528 sec. 4(a) itself ended the Board on July 1, 1989 unless extended, and EO 12692 sec. 3 describes the committee as terminated, so the first end of the Board may be July 1, 1989; either date gives NO. A search of the held full-run texts for '12604' finds EO 12692 and unrelated page-number hits in EO 9638 and EO 9639; no held later instrument names or restores EO 12604 or EO 12528. The 1989 snapshot row (amends other document) agrees its effect merged into EO 12528. Both history observations were reviewed. Provisional NO hypothesis; the first effective end (July 1, 1989 own term of the amended parent, or September 30, 1989 revocation) is not adjudicated.
